name: grantAbilityPart
signature: export function grantAbilityPart(grant: readonly string[] | undefined): EffectPart | null
contract: Returns one EffectPart at 6a adding the named abilities, lower-cased, because layers.ts compares ability strings case-sensitively and the compiler emits mixed case.
An empty or absent list returns null rather than an empty part: computeLayers already filters effects with no parts, and an empty part would be a silent no-op that still consumed a timestamp.
Never removes abilities. Removal is a different modification with different CR 613.6 consequences.
